headline: Adopted policies B3, B4, and C4; appointed Nathan Lavery as CESA Director/Representative; approved Policy 2.1 monitoring report.
summary: The school board adopted three district policies on second reading covering alcohol and drug testing and English learners. The board also appointed Nathan Lavery as the CESA Director/Representative and took action on Policy 2.1 regarding treatment of students, parents, and guardians. The board then went into executive session to discuss personnel matters.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including routine financial reports, hiring recommendations, and prior training minutes.
Appointed Nathan Lavery as CESA Director/Representative to the Chittenden Central CESA board.
Adopted policies B3 Alcohol and Drug-Free Workplace, B4 Drug and Alcohol Testing: Transportation Employees, and C4 English Learners.
